description: This file defines a UI component named 'EmptyState' using the Lightning.js framework. It includes methods to add a new note to the store and renders a UI with a message and a button to create a note.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A UI component that displays a message when there are no notes and provides an interface to create the first note.

methods.name: createFirst
methods.description: Adds a new, empty note (with empty title and content) to the store.
